newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin up four cents to 15.06 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin up four cents to 15.06 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose four cents to 15.06 ringgit ($6.04) a kg after short-covering by players and overnight gains on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good buying today but I think it had to do more with short-covering than the higher LME," said a dealer. The LME rose $5 on Tuesday.
Turnover fell to 113 tonnes from 125 on Tuesday. Bids totalled 130 tonnes against offers of 113. The local premium widened to $45 from $40. Buyers were Europeans and locals.
